summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on reviewing recently recovered traffic data for multiple companies. Initial concerns were raised regarding a potential spike in activity observed specifically for CityMedia over the last couple of days, and whether this was due to internal recovery efforts or external changes.

Multiple checks confirmed that general performance across most countries appeared normal. Regarding CityMedia, while initial concern persisted, subsequent checks indicated no major issues with sensors or data integrity. The team reviewed the dashboard and specific facility data (using a SQL query example) to verify session metrics.

By the end of the discussion, multiple participants confirmed that the traffic data for CityMedia looked good, and overall system stability was achieved after applying fixes.
decisions: The immediate concern regarding lost traffic data was addressed and resolved.
It was determined that the observed spike in CityMedia's activity did not represent a critical anomaly.
action_items: Monitor general traffic performance across all facilities, paying attention to any recurring anomalies.
